desc: Fishing float spirit: pale blue and white bobber body, gold hook tail, ripple ring base. Face: two tiny bright dot eyes high on the body and a small open smile. Abstract spirit creature, no animal parts. Cute and cool chibi, right-facing 3/4. 16-bit pixel art, 1px navy outline, 2-3 flat shades, no gradients, no noise. Lavender, white, violet, gold palette. No halo, sparkles or shadow.
